title: A Detailed Morpho-Kinematic Model of [...] NGC 2392. A Unifying View with the Cat's Eye and Saturn Planetary Nebulae

evidence.locator: Sect. III.1: the inner shell's velocity ellipse reaches about 120 km/s either side of the systemic velocity (70.5 km/s) at the central slit; its main axis points slightly south and south-west of the observer. Sect. III.2: the outer shell is a narrow velocity ellipse of about 16 km/s, close to an expanding sphere; the cometary knots are at the systemic velocity, so they lie in a disc close to the plane of the sky. Sect. III.3: the caps, about 55 km/s, in front of and behind the inner shell; the northern ones recede. Sect. VI: outer shell angular radius 23 arcsec at 16 km/s; inner shell a deformed prolate spheroid, 120 km/s along its major axis, tilted 9 degrees from the line of sight, pointing towards position angle 205 degrees; homologous law v = k r / r0 with a different k for each component; cometary knots on an equatorial disc at a radius of about 17 arcsec; caps placed at the edge of the outer shell, two behind (north and west) and one in front (south); jet 165 to 180 km/s.
